mapper.insert: insert into ledger(ledger_name, create_time) values (#{ledgerName}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
insert into user_ledger_relation(user_id, ledger_id, create_time, is_owner) values (#{userId}, #{ledgerId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 1)
